releases.name: Version 1.2.0
releases.body:
- Added learn quantum frequency setting
- Added original quit menu button position setting
- Added bonks: Ship, Shuttle, Stranger, HEL, 0g Cave
- Added freeze supernova setting
- Added no alt tab pause setting
- Fixed menu storage overwriting Solanum & Prisoner settings
- Dark Bramble now gets automatically locked on in the Feldsparring practice state
- Warp timer no longer starts on vessel clip practice state
- Feldsparring timer no longer starts on vessel practice state
- Renamed timers: Museum -> Observe Flight, Observe -> Observatory, Museum+Observe -> Observe
releases.bodyZh:
- 添加了学习量子频率设置
- 添加了原始退出菜单按钮位置设置
- 添加了撞击：飞船、穿梭机、陌生人、HEL、0g洞穴
- 添加了冻结超新星设置
- 添加了无Alt Tab暂停设置
- 修复了菜单存储覆盖所莱内姆 & 囚犯设置
- 黑棘星现在在费尔德斯巴练习状态下会自动锁定
- 跃迁计时器不再在飞船剪辑练习状态下开始
- 费尔德斯巴计时器不再在飞船练习状态下开始
- 重命名计时器：博物馆 -> 观察飞行，观察 -> 天文台，博物馆+观察 -> 观察

releases.name: Version 1.1.1
releases.body:
- Toggle speedup keybind now works when sleeping at a campfire
- Practice states now start with full jetpack boost
- Fixed inputfade not being set to 1 when loading in eye scene
releases.bodyZh:
- 在篝火旁睡觉时，加速键绑定现在可以正常工作
- 练习状态现在以满喷射推进器加成开始
- 修复了在加载宇宙之眼场景时inputfade未设置为1的问题

releases.name: Version 1.1.0
releases.body:
## New Features
- Added village practice state
- Added fill in eye coordinates setting for vessel clip practice state
- Added solanum & prisoner settings for instrument hunt practice state
- Added menu storage setting for instrument hunt practice state
- Added suitless practice states setting
- Added give warpcore and give dream lantern keybinds
- Added village, museum, museum+observe and coordinates timer
- Added 7 more custom practice states (10 total now)
releases.bodyZh:
## 新功能
- 新增村庄练习状态
- 新增飞船剪辑练习状态的填写坐标设置
- 新增所莱内姆(索莱内姆)与囚犯的设置用于仪器狩猎练习状态
- 新增仪器狩猎练习状态的菜单存储设置
- 新增无宇航服练习状态设置
- 新增给予跃迁核心和给予梦境灯笼的按键绑定
- 新增村庄、博物馆、博物馆+观察和坐标计时器
- 新增7个自定义练习状态（现在共有10个）

releases.name: Version 1.0.2
releases.body:
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed custom practice state position/rotation format being localized. And added error message if format is wrong
releases.bodyZh:
## 修复问题
- 修复了自定义练习状态位置/旋转格式本地化的问题。如果格式错误，则添加了错误信息

releases.name: Version 1.0.1
releases.body:
## Bug fixes
- Practice states no longer reset playerdata on default
- Fixed signalscope UI not loading in on first zoom
- Fixed custom practice states not working in different languages
releases.bodyZh:
## 错误修复
- 练习状态不再在默认情况下重置玩家数据
- 修复了信号镜UI在第一次缩放时无法加载的问题
- 修复了自定义练习状态在不同语言中无法工作的问题
